theTwoLegsSideBySide.schemaNote: Both legs read the same fields off the same URL with the same instrument, so the difference is the product's and not the probe's. The pre-fix leg is captured in _inbox/2026-09-18_g161-bare-visit-pre-fix.json and cannot be re-measured: its deployment was replaced by the post-fix one.

REQUIRED_FIELD_DEVIATION_STATED_NOT_WORK: Unlike the pre-fix leg, this leg has NO screenshot beside it. browser_take_screenshot timed out twice during a period when the machine was running 149 chrome processes (this lane's own local a11y scan plus other work), and it was not retried a third time: the measurement that matters here is the DOM reading above, which is captured verbatim in this file, and a screenshot would only be a rendering of the same numbers. Recorded as a refusal rather than papered over, and the browser session is named so the leg is reproducible.
browserSession: cursor-ide-browser, viewId 190544, one existing tab reused; the tab had held the pre-fix bare visit, so the post-fix reading required an explicit browser_navigate to the same URL before the evaluate. browser_lock was taken before the evaluate and released after.
whyThereIsNoProbeScript: _inbox/2026-09-18_g161-never-default-a-city_uat-probe.mjs measures the ROUTES (its client block only asks whether the shipped app.js matches certain substrings). It cannot measure a rendered visit, because a browser reading is what distinguishes 'the client was told no city' from 'the client guessed one'. Stated rather than implied, so neither artifact is read as having been produced by the other's instrument.
